cues.en: The reason Spark is a big deal is because it's very efficient at distributing the processing of massive data sets across a cluster, and in a reliable manner.
cues.zh: Spark 重要，是因為能高效、可靠地把巨量資料處理，分散到叢集。

cues.en: Architecturally it looks like this, you write a driver script, in either Python, Scala, or Java, that defines how you want to process your data, using the APIs Spark provides.
cues.zh: 架構上，像這樣：用 Python、Scala 或 Java 寫驅動指令碼，透過 Spark API，定義如何處理資料。

cues.en: Once you launch that driver script, which is usually from the master node of your cluster, it will communicate with your cluster manager to allocate the resources it needs from your cluster.
cues.zh: 通常從叢集主節點啟動，與叢集管理員通訊，分配資源。

cues.en: That cluster manager could be Hadoop's YARN cluster manager if you're running Spark on top of a Hadoop cluster, or Spark has its own cluster manager as well if you want to use it instead.
cues.zh: 若 Spark 跑在 Hadoop，管理員可以是 YARN，也能用 Spark 自己的管理員。

cues.en: That cluster manager allocates a bunch of executor processes across your cluster that will do the actual work of processing your data.
cues.zh: 管理員在叢集分配一批 executor 程序，實際處理資料。

cues.en: Spark handles all the details of figuring out how to divide your data up and process it in the most efficient manner.
cues.zh: Spark 處理如何切分資料、最有效處理的細節。

cues.en: It does this by keeping things in memory as much as possible, trying to process data on the actual nodes it is stored on, and using something called a directed acyclic graph
cues.zh: 盡量保留記憶體、在資料實際所在節點處理，並用有向無環圖，

cues.en: to organize the processing in the most efficient way it can.
cues.zh: 組織最有效的處理方式。

cues.en: All of these different components can talk to each other when necessary, which might become necessary if a machine in your cluster goes down or something.
cues.zh: 必要時，各元件能互相通訊，例如叢集機器故障。

cues.en: It's all rather resilient.
cues.zh: 相當有韌性。

cues.en: For example, even though the cluster manager looks like a single point of failure in this simplified diagram, you can set things up so you have a backup cluster manager ready to take over if necessary.
cues.zh: 例如，簡圖中管理員看來是單點故障，但能設定備援，必要時接手。

cues.en: From a software developer standpoint, Spark consists of a core that manages all the distribution of work that we talked about, and there are other libraries on top of Spark that you generally work with.
cues.zh: 開發者角度，Spark 核心管理分散工作，其上還有一般使用的函式庫。

cues.en: Spark SQL for example defines something called a DataSet, and this allows you to work with Spark in much the same way as you would with a SQL database.
cues.zh: 例如 Spark SQL 定義 Dataset，讓你像使用 SQL 資料庫，操作 Spark。

cues.en: This has become the standard way of using Spark now, DataSets are the future.
cues.zh: 現在已成標準方式，Dataset 是未來。

cues.en: Spark Streaming allows you to ingest data in real time and process it as it comes in, and it also offers something called Structured Streaming that even lets you treat that real-time data as SQL data.
cues.zh: Spark Streaming 能即時接收、處理資料，也有 Structured Streaming，甚至能把即時資料當 SQL 資料。

cues.en: GraphX exists for analyzing and processing data organized in a graph data structure, such as social networks.
cues.zh: GraphX 分析、處理社群網路等圖結構資料。

cues.en: What we're most interested in, however, is MLLib, that's Spark's machine learning library.
cues.zh: 但我們最關心 MLlib，也就是 Spark 機器學習函式庫。

cues.en: As we'll see, it contains classes that make recommendation generation from massive datasets really simple.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到，有類別讓巨量資料推薦，非常簡單。

cues.en: Before we dive into some code, there is one concept you'll need, the RDD.
cues.zh: 程式之前，先了解 RDD。

cues.en: RDD stands for resilient distributed dataset, and it's at the core of Spark if you're not using its SQL interfaces instead.
cues.zh: 代表彈性分散式資料集，不用 SQL 介面時，它是 Spark 核心。

cues.en: An RDD is an object that encapsulates the data you want to process.
cues.zh: RDD 是封裝待處理資料的物件。

cues.en: When you write a Spark driver script, what you're really doing is defining operations on RDDs that all tie together somehow, and ultimately lead to some sort of desired output at the end.
cues.zh: 驅動指令碼，其實定義相互連接的 RDD 運算，最後導向所需輸出。

cues.en: You define where the RDD should load its data from, what operations and aggregations it should perform on that data, and where to write its output when it's done.
cues.zh: 定義 RDD 從哪載入資料、做什麼運算與彙整、完成寫到哪。

cues.en: Kind of like with TensorFlow, nothing actually happens until you kick things off and request that final output, you're really just allowing Spark to build up a graph of the operations it needs to do to fulfill
cues.zh: 有點像 TensorFlow，直到啟動、要求最終輸出，才真正發生事情；先讓 Spark 建立滿足

cues.en: what you want, and then you start that graph.
cues.zh: 需求的運算圖，再啟動。

cues.en: From a programming standpoint, this is really nice because you only think about RDDs and the operations you're applying to all of the data within them.
cues.zh: 程式角度，很好，只要思考 RDD 與套用在資料上的運算。

cues.en: The RDD hides all of Spark's complexity in distributing those operations across a cluster, and in handling node failures and things like that.
cues.zh: RDD 隱藏跨叢集分散運算、處理節點故障等複雜性。

cues.en: You don't worry about the distributed computing part, you just worry about how you want to transform your data.
cues.zh: 不擔心分散式運算，只想如何轉換資料。

cues.en: Of course in the world of technology, nothing can stay the same for long and this is true of Spark as well.
cues.zh: 當然，科技不會長期不變，Spark 也是。

cues.en: Spark has introduced alternative APIs over time that build upon the RDD.
cues.zh: 隨時間，推出建立在 RDD 上的其他 API。

cues.en: So, while you can still code against RDDs if you want lower-level control over what your driver script does, DataFrames were introduced that treat the underlying data as Row objects that allow you to code against it
cues.zh: 要低階控制，仍能用 RDD，但也推出 DataFrame，把底層資料當 Row 物件，讓你像

cues.en: like you would a SQL database.
cues.zh: SQL 資料庫一樣寫程式。

cues.en: You can convert an RDD into a DataFrame if you want to.
cues.zh: 可以將 RDD 轉 DataFrame。

cues.en: Spark 2 introduced the DataSet, which is like a DataFrame except it has better type safety, so you can catch more errors in your driver script at compile time instead of at runtime.
cues.zh: Spark 2 推出 Dataset，像 DataFrame，但型別安全更好，編譯時就能抓更多錯誤，不必等執行。

cues.en: Spark 2 uses the DataSet as a common language between all of its components, which also helps to simplify development.
cues.zh: Spark 2 用 Dataset，作為元件共同語言，也簡化開發。

cues.en: You can also convert a DataFrame into a DataSet and vice versa, technically, a DataFrame is exactly the same thing as a DataSet of Row objects.
cues.zh: DataFrame 與 Dataset 互轉；嚴格說，DataFrame 就是 Row 物件的 Dataset。

cues.en: But, there's a catch, they don't work in R or Python, so if you're developing in Python you have to stick with DataFrame objects instead as Spark's common component.
cues.zh: 但有個問題，不支援 R 或 Python，因此 Python 必須維持用 DataFrame，作為共同元件。

cues.en: DataSets are also a little bit slower, so some people choose to stick with DataFrames even outside of Python.
cues.zh: Dataset 也稍慢，因此有些人，即使不用 Python，仍用 DataFrame。

cues.en: This is all kind of confusing, so why am I telling you this?
cues.zh: 有點混淆，為什麼說這些？

cues.en: Well, our example in Python will start off using the RDD interface for the initial cleanup and structuring of our input ratings data.
cues.zh: Python 範例，一開始用 RDD，清理、組織評分輸入。

cues.en: But then, we have to convert it to a DataFrame because that's what Spark's machine learning library expects as input.
cues.zh: 之後要轉 DataFrame，因為 Spark ML 函式庫預期這種輸入。

cues.en: DataSets aren't relevant to us because we're coding in Python, but it's a term you'll hear a lot when people talk about Spark.
cues.zh: 我們用 Python，Dataset 不適用，但談 Spark 時，經常聽到。

cues.en: So with all that out of the way, let's take a look at a real Spark driver script and create some real recommendations with it.
cues.zh: 介紹完，看看真正的 Spark 驅動指令碼，產生推薦。
